description: The line plot illustrates the similarity of different layer-wise mixtures-of-experts (MEs) for multilingual language models (LLMs) across various layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Similarity," is also linear, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. There are four lines in the plot, each representing a different mixture-of-experts configuration. The red line, labeled "en&en," starts at a similarity of approximately 0.05, peaks at around 0.35 between layers 4 and 6, and ends at approximately 0.45 at layer 22. The blue line, labeled "en&es," begins at a similarity of about 0.05, peaks at roughly 0.30 between layers 4 and 6, and concludes at about 0.45 at layer 22. The green line, labeled "en&el," starts at a similarity of around 0.05, peaks at approximately 0.25 between layers 4 and 6, and ends at about 0.45 at layer 22. Lastly, the purple line, labeled "en&bn," begins at a similarity of about 0.05, peaks at roughly 0.20 between layers 4 and 6, and concludes at about 0.45 at layer 22. All lines show a general trend of increasing similarity as the layer number increases, with notable peaks and declines at specific layers.
